Anita and Vibhuti lodge a formal police complaint against their neighbour Tiwari. Consequently, the commissioner advises a local resolution at the colony.
Vibhuti resolves to represent Tiwari legally after noticing Angoori's distress. Meanwhile, Anita intervenes to rescue Tillu when Tiwari attempts to mistreat him again at Ammaji's bidding.
Anita and Vibhuti confront one another during a tense courtroom session. Later, Angoori informs Anita about the unfolding situation, causing the proceedings to be stopped.
Vibhuti Narayan Mishra and Manmohan Tiwari live in the same neighbourhood in Kanpur. They both try to impress each other's wives but end up landing in peculiar situations.
Anita anticipates Vibhuti's arrival but David and Helen obstruct her access to the room. Meanwhile, Tillu and Malkhan express deep regret to Teeka.
Vibhuti manages to stop Tikli from consuming poison. In the meantime, Tiwari questions Anita about being with Veer Singh.
Tiwari takes Angoori to eat Pani Puri with her and sees Anita there with Veer Singh. Later, Anita tells Angoori that she is taking Veer's help to make Vibhuti feel jealous.
Angoori enjoys street food alongside Veer Singh to provoke Tiwari's envy. Later, Tiwari leaves under the cover of darkness to assault Veer.
Prem informs Angoori about Vibhuti's remarkable artistic talent during his college years. Later, she performs a dance to motivate him into picking up his art once more.
Angoori performs a dance to assist Vibhuti as he creates her portrait. Meanwhile, Prem masquerades as David's international companion, Tom, in an attempt to purchase the artwork.
Tiwari asks Vibhuti to make a painting and Anita finalises the deal for INR 50,000. Later, inspired by Angoori's dance, Vibhuti makes a painting and Prem, disguised as Tom, offers INR 5 lakhs for it.
Teeka and his friends commission Vibhuti to create an original piece of artwork. However, Tom declines to purchase the painting.
Vibhuti pretends to be Raju's guide and Tiwari struggles after incurring a loss in the stock market as well as his business.
A team of comedians, the 'Mahabalis', perform outrageous, funny skits with their witty 'Yoddhas', poking fun at everything with laughter, satire, and hilarious punchlines.
Furious, Anita banishes Vibhuti from their residence, prompting him to disguise himself as a beggar. Meanwhile, authorities search for Vibhuti as Manmohan offers a reward for his capture.
Vibhuti's cartoon sketch of Anita incurs her wrath. In an attempt to impress her, Manmohan falsely claims to be a painter and finds himself obliged to create her portrait.
Manmohan lets Saxena paint Anita's portrait and later exchanges it with his own. Vibhuti, dressed as a nawab, lures Manmohan with money and forces him to admit the truth.
Vibhuti overhears Angoori mourning her friend, Chatanki, and decides to exploit her nostalgia. He fakes a possession by Chatanki's spirit, delighting Angoori while causing Manmohan immense distress.
While Vibhuti interacts with Angoori disguised as Chatanki, Anita calls a doctor to treat him. After discovering Vibhuti's secret, Manmohan begins impersonating Chatanki himself.
Pretending to be possessed, Manmohan arrives at Tiwari's bedroom and thrashes Vibhuti. Later, to irritate Angoori, Manmohan alternates from being himself to Chantaki's spirit.
Vibhuti is mistakenly portrayed as a criminal in the newspaper. As a result, everyone starts ignoring him, causing him to feel confused.
Tiwari falsely accuses Vibhuti of wanting to kill him, turning Anita against her husband. As a result, Anita stops talking to Vibhuti, leaving him heartbroken.
Anita tells her uncle that she regrets having rejected the idea of marrying a banker in the past before she ended up marrying Vibhuti. Later, her uncle wants to know what Vibhuti's profession is.
Anita tells her uncle that Vibhuti is the CEO of a multinational company. Further, her uncle is delighted and says that he wishes to meet him.
To stop an engagement, Angoori falsely claims she is pregnant with Vibhuti's child. After various schemes involving Teeka and Malkhan, it is revealed that Vishambhar knew the truth all along.
Against Vibhuti's wishes, Anita decides to rent out her living room. Tiwari seizes the chance and deliberately picks a fight with Angoori to justify moving in.
Vibhuti Narayan Mishra and Manmohan Tiwari live in the same neighbourhood in Kanpur. They both try to impress each other's wives but end up landing in peculiar situations.
Vibhuti decides to defraud an insurance company to get five lakh rupees for Anita's uncle. Subsequently, he fakes his own death by pretending to fall from a hill to claim the money.
In the chaotic environment of a faraway psychiatric hospital, love blossoms between a closed-off doctor and a rebellious patient with a troubled past.
Disguised as an elder, Vibhuti defends his own honour during the prayer meet. An insurance agent arrives to verify the demise while a ghostly Vibhuti later haunts a terrified yet charmed Angoori.
Tiwari becomes suspicious when he catches Anita romancing a supposedly dead Vibhuti. Later, Vibhuti appears as a ghost before Tiwari.
Vibhuti fakes being a ghost to scare friends but 'resurrects' when David mentions a massive inheritance. The wealth vanishes when David's accounts are frozen, and Anita leaves dinner in a huff.
Enraged by Vibhuti praising Angoor's cooking while ignoring her feelings, a jealous Anita resolves to prove her own culinary mastery to everyone.
Furious at Lord Shiva's remarks, Parvati departs from Kailash and resides on the Vindhyachal Mountain. Later, Narad informs the Tridevis regarding Anusuya's austerity.
Narad poses Anusuya's vow as a test before the Tridevis. Subsequently, Parvati sends a note to Lord Shiva, and he agrees to her proposal.

Brothers Sonu and Monu's regular pranks worry their father. However, their lives take a turn when they fall in love and go to great lengths to impress the girls' father.
Dr Anmol, a dentist and henpecked husband, lives a miserable existence in New York due to his domineering wife. However, his troubles increase when he unwittingly gets embroiled in a mafia rivalry.
Mumbai-based couple Puneet and Munmun's lives are turned upside down when a distant relative arrives at their doorstep and starts meddling in their personal and professional affairs.
When a revenge-driven circus entertainer threatens to bleed a Chicago-based banking giant dry, an Indian policeman must leap into action with an eccentric sidekick to save the day.
A man, diagnosed with brain cancer, seeks to obtain 'nagmani' to become immortal. However, deadly challenges await when a mystical cobra shows up.

A group of college students are forced to take shelter in the mysterious Krishna Cottage for the night. Little do they know that a spirit haunts the house.
Vikram Batra, a young man, dreams of becoming a soldier and falls in love with Dimple. Soon after his training, he climbs the military ranks and contributes to India's victory in the Kargil war.
Suresh and Vinnie are childhood friends who are passionate about dancing. They form a dance group but face many hurdles to participate in the Las Vegas dancing competition.

Cupid strikes when Pritam, a single father, comes across his college sweetheart, Geeta, in Goa. However, when their respective children go to war with each other, the two find it difficult to reunite.
After his wealthy family prohibits him from marrying the woman he is in love with, Devdas's life spirals downward as he takes up alcohol and a life of vice to alleviate the pain.
A Pakistani general hires a private terror outfit to conduct attacks in India while Pathaan, an Indian secret agent, is on a mission to form a special unit.
